articles.title: U.S. reveals import ban on slew of Canadian goods as trade war escalates
articles.summary: The White House said it would ban imports of Canadian motorbikes and a slew of other products starting later this month as diplomatic and trade relations with Ottawa continue to fray. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said the moves were a "natural consequence of Canada's continued discriminatory treatment of crucial American exports."
